text.tspan: Prerequisites: external IdP access token, space membership, registered type and policy, versioned bucket
All control requests carry Bearer JWT, API validates signature,
issuer, audience, expiry and exchange scope
Service checks current membership and applicable ownership,
SDK may retry POST R/{record}/publish, receive 409 attachments_not_verified,
GET the record and sleep while verification is pending
Verification marks attachments verified, the record
Normal successful path shown, upload retries, failed verification and cleanup are omitted
Large client uploads bypass the API, the worker reads stored bytes to verify them

svg.text: POST R with metadata, attachment sizes and SHA-256,
Uploading state, protocol and part size
ListParts after ownership and state checks
PUT bytes directly using signed URL
Select due attempts, acquire database lease
GET exact object VersionId and stream bytes
If lease still owned, commit verified binding and
POST R/{record}/publish with persisted idempotency key
